issues: Source page is a faded/handwritten typewriter-era engineering tabulation; many cell values include OCR-suspect characters (e.g., '-83/.13', '-02.04', bare '+14'/'+56' without decimals). CSV preserves the page Markdown verbatim and may not be numerically reliable.
Upper tabulation rightmost 'constants' column sometimes contains two values in a single cell (e.g., '-1.66 -7072.44'); these were split into two trailing CSV columns where present.
Lower tabulation is a sparse staircase matrix with many empty cells and several 'TERM' placeholders; column count was preserved as in the page Markdown.
